answer: Identity Bond Decay: each agent posts a 50-credit bond to join, and it melts like a glacier, losing 5% each epoch until gone. To forge a fake identity, an attacker must post a fresh bond per alias, so 100 aliases cost 5,000 credits while each bond shrinks and earns nothing. The waste rises like a plume of smoke, then the bond vanishes. Honest agents pay once, their bond refilled by real earnings, so one honest identity outlasts a hundred fakes.
